subject: [PATCH 1/2] mm/mremap: fix locked_vm leak from MREMAP_DONTUNMAP self-merge

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about mlock semantics of MREMAP_DONTUNMAP, suggesting it might be surprising or incorrect to unlock the source in this case.

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Confirmed that unlocking the source is unavoidable due to page tables being moved, and agreed to update man pages.

2026-09-28.patch_summary: Patch addresses a locked_vm leak issue in MREMAP_DONTUNMAP self-merge, but raises questions about mlock semantics.
